Forty-two printed regions on eight systems. The piece opens in treble and bass with two sharps and a 3/4 sign, and the first region is a one-beat pickup. Four later clef glyphs are printed on the lower staff: treble in the middle of P008, bass in the middle of P009, treble in the middle of P016, and bass immediately before the double barline of P017, governing P018. System 4 reprints that treble clef at its left edge; it is not another change. A thin-thin double barline with no repeat dots separates the two-beat partial P017 from the one-beat pickup P018.
